gemini.style: Read this as a warm, upbeat, friendly narrator for a short software product demo video, at a natural unhurried pace. Say "PIP" as the word "pip", "EOB" as the letters "E O B", and "GEICO" as "GUY-co"

scenes.text: Meet EOB Genie. It turns a stack of scanned auto and PIP EOBs into a checked, posted ledger, in about a minute.
Here's the usual pile: explanations of review from GEICO, Progressive and USAA, plus the checks, all in one scan. Normally, someone keys in every line by hand.
With EOB Genie, you upload the whole scan, mixed payers, checks and health-insurance pages included. The file is read, then thrown away. It's never stored.
While the genie reads, you get a little show. It reads every line, matches each EOB to its patient, and checks the PIP math.
Three EOBs found in eight pages, each matched to the right patient and coverage, by claim number, or by name and date of loss.

Every number is checked against the paper: the line totals, the allowed totals, and the payment against eighty percent of the allowed amount. Anything unusual, like a code allowed at your full charge, is flagged.
If the EOB says benefits are exhausted, the genie flags it, moves the balance to the patient, and switches the case to a letter of protection when no other coverage is left.
Got an EOB for someone who isn't set up yet? Create the patient and the auto case right from the EOB.
Save, and it's posted to the ledger: the payment, the fee-schedule adjustment, and the twenty percent moved to the patient balance.
It's still your ledger. Open any EOB to fix a line or add a late check, and the posting updates to match.
Then the EOB Genie report shows what to act on, across every case.
Money left on the table: lines that were underpaid or denied, with a pre-suit demand letter one click away. And fees that may sit below the PIP fee schedule.
Paid late? It counts the days and figures the interest due. It also catches bills with no EOB yet, and bills sent after Florida's billing window.
And it warns you before PIP runs out, so the letter of protection is signed in time.
Your patients' documents are never stored. EOB Genie reads the scan, keeps only the numbers you approve, and every access is logged.
EOB Genie is included in Gold and Platinum, or get it on its own for forty-nine dollars a month.
Start your free trial at injurycase dot com, and let the genie read your EOBs.
